notes.title: New Joltt - Battle Pillars demo available!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]The playable demo of Joltt - Battle Pillars has been updated![/p][p]Many changes were applied, but here are the main ones:[/p][list][*][p]I added the online mode for the demo! So far it's only the custom room online mode, but the ranked mode will also be added to the demo closer to the release. Right now, you can create your custom room, send the room name to your friend and you will be able to play with them online. This is a first version of the online mode, so feel free to let me know if you encounter bugs. And yes, you will be able to challenge people playing the full game even if you only own the demo! [/p][/*][*][p]I reworked the main menu to make it more clear : solo modes are now regrouped under a single entry on the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]I added the options menu in addition to the keyboard config menu. You have now access to various options, such as the game speed, the platforms HP, activating the attacks from the judges, the number of points to win the game, sound settings, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]New solo modes have been added: VS CPU and Story mode. You can still play the first 4 challenges of characters available in the demo, of course. Also feel free to follow the tutorial before playing.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310638/246be94039a5b2e6c6754c39775e1cb422c4ca29.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The full release is planned for end of this year. The exact date will be announced soon. In the meantime, please have fun with the demo and let me know about any feedback you have! I'm 100% dedicated to make the game as good and balanced as possible. [/p][p]I hope you'll enjoy playing the demo of Joltt - Battle Pillars! [/p][p]Take care,[/p][p]Pablo[/p]
